chapter: Friends, New York life and recording routine
title: Going to New York to record, six-month stays
summary: She went to New York to record in 1924 and 1925, staying six or seven months each time though her brother objected.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: In 1924, you left Chicago to go to New York. Why did you go to New York then?
Oh, they called you to make the records, uh-huh. I see. And then that's when you made --
But my brother didn't want me to go.

He wanted me to (unintelligible). But Mr. ________ told me in New York City, told me, said, anytime I come to record, always bring some of George's songs because George was the one that made you acquainted with us. But my brother didn't know that, but he (unintelligible) number to record ________. But he didn't know that.
So when you went to New York a couple of times in 1924, you went in 1925, did you go just for the recording? You didn't stay there?
The only time I go, (unintelligible). I wouldn't go and do all the recording one day. I'd stay six or seven months ________.
